premise.claim: DataLoad and DataBackup pods for Alluxio "always used the controller value, so a DataLoad on a runtime whose images live in its own private registry couldn't pull the image" (PR body); issue #6247: "a DataLoad on that runtime still runs with the controller wide secrets, so it fails to pull if the image lives in the same private registry"
premise.reportedComponent: Alluxio DataLoad/DataBackup value-file generation (pkg/ddc/alluxio), JuiceFS parts deferred
premise.evidence: On merge-base ff99142 with runtime spec.imagePullSecrets=[runtime-secret] and env IMAGE_PULL_SECRETS=env-secret-should-be-replaced, the generated DataLoad/DataBackup value files carry [{env-secret-should-be-replaced}], not the runtime secret — see results/base-unit.out

liveNote: L3 (skipped for this review, unit+integration only per round policy): create an AlluxioRuntime with spec.imagePullSecrets and no IMAGE_PULL_SECRETS on the controller, run a DataLoad, and confirm the loader job pod spec lists the runtime's secret (kubectl get pod -o jsonpath='{.spec.imagePullSecrets}').
